title: Immediate response after discovery of a quality-related event
rule_summary: On discovery of a quality-related event, the pharmacist must immediately notify the patient or representative, notify the prescriber when professionally indicated, and give corrective and harm-minimization directions.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply qre notification requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Immediate response after discovery of a quality-related event

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing qre notification with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
